item.title: 'The Odyssey' Cast Debunks a Major Misconception About Working with Christopher Nolan
item.description: But according to the cast and crew of The Odyssey , there's another side to Nolan that audiences might not expect. Behind the intense focus and demanding production schedules is a filmmaker with a sharp sense of humor who genuinely loves being on a movie set.

item.title: Quentin Tarantino's Western Thriller Masterpiece Is Officially Free on Streaming
item.description: As far as Quentin Tarantino movies go, just about everyone loves Pulp Fiction . Reservoir Dogs and Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood are also widely regarded, while the Kill Bill films and Django Unchained each have a pretty fervent fanbase. But with so many great entries in his filmography, it’s inevitable that at least a few of his movies would get lost in the shuffle. One of those often overlooked films is his 2015 Western thriller, which may not be top-tier Tarantino, but it’s still an excellent film that combines the strengths of two of his previous entries.

item.title: 5 Years Later, 'Yellowjackets' Officially Solves One of Its Last Huge Mysteries
item.description: Yellowjackets has plenty of mysteries that have yet to be answered as the twisty survival thriller reaches its final season . Is the show supernatural or just a psychological thriller? Are there more adult Yellowjackets still alive? What does the symbol the teen Yellowjackets keep finding in the wilderness mean?

item.title: George R.R. Martin’s 7 Best Non-Game of Thrones Books, Ranked
item.description: George R.R. Martin will forever be associated with his book series, A Song of Ice and Fire , and HBO’s adaptation, Game of Thrones , but there's considerably more to his bibliography than scheming Lannisters, fire-breathing dragons, and the unending wait for The Winds of Winter . Long before Westeros became a cultural phenomenon, Martin was building a reputation as one of science fiction and fantasy's most imaginative voices, writing everything from supernatural mysteries and vampiric thrillers to sprawling space operas and intimate character dramas.

item.title: Gary Larson's 10 Greatest 'Far Side' Comics, Ranked
item.description: What, exactly, is the measure of greatness when it comes to comic strips ? The daily newspaper comic is a very limiting art form, with only a few panels — sometimes just one panel — to make a joke. Because of its brevity, it's easy to trivialize the medium as simply the “funny papers,” a daily, disposable art form designed to pick you up after reading the actual news.

item.title: Goodbye 'Rings of Power,' Prime Video’s Legendary 48-Episode Fantasy Series Is Even Better
item.description: Rings of Power is back on Prime Video for a third helping of fantasy storytelling, and we won’t pretend we aren’t enamored with all the shenanigans happening in Middle-earth right now. Still, considering how much Amazon has spent on the series (and how incoherent parts of the story can be), we’re not convinced it's the streamer’s best fantasy show. In our minds, that honor belongs to another.

item.title: 9 Calvin and Hobbes Comics from the 1990s that Prove Bill Watterson is a Genius
item.description: Calvin and Hobbes creator Bill Watterson is a genius . Over the course of ten years spanning more than 3,000 comic strips , he developed two truly irresistible characters that are still beloved by millions. There was a lot behind the success of Calvin and Hobbes , but I think part of the reason why Watterson is still so widely respected is that he was an incredibly versatile artist who managed to do a lot of different things in an artform that can sometimes be limiting.
